sites.name: Giza Plateau (Pyramids and Great Sphinx)
sites.what: Pyramids of Khufu, Khafre and Menkaure, the Great Sphinx and surrounding tombs.

access.opening: Daily 8 am to 4 pm on the ministry site page; 7 am to 5 pm on the ministry price list.
access.tickets: Foreign adult area entry EGP 700, student EGP 350; does not include entering the pyramids. Inside Khufu's pyramid EGP 1,000 (price list), Khafre EGP 280. No RBA rate for EGP.

sites.name: Saqqara
sites.era: ancient (era not stated on the pages read)
sites.what: Saqqara area, including the Pyramid of Djoser complex and the pyramids of Unas and Teti (as listed on the ticket).

access.tickets: Foreign adult EGP 600, student EGP 300; ticket for all Saqqara tombs EGP 1,000. No RBA rate for EGP.
